# Copilot agent instructions (pointer only)

Before **every** agent task, read the latest [root agent contract](../AGENTS.md), [canonical execution plan](../AUTOPILOT_PLAN.md) (including its mandatory dated P01 queue and GitHub Actions billing policy), [scientific gate status](../PROJECT_STATE.yaml), [M0-M6 task tracker](https://github.com/MatPomGit/arc-rgbt/issues/21), active issue/PR and relevant protocol. Follow the ordered prerequisites and STOP/GO rules. Record the plan version and exact SHA used in the task summary. Re-read on each run and after any plan update.

This adapter adds no separate scientific, security, billing or authorization policy. The canonical files prevail. Public standard GitHub-hosted Actions minutes are free; do not use larger paid runners or paid integrations without authorization. For P01, university APC funding is a planning assumption, not submission or payment approval.
